items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Yes, Anita. And he said, Mama Anita. Either Mama Anita or Mama Nita. See? Which means little mama.

ctx.x: Yes, Anita. And he said, Mama Anita. Either Mama Anita or Mama Nita. See? Which means little mama.
Well, how about Stratford Hunch? Does that mean anything at all? Stratford?
